name: Anthropic Claude
description: An Anthropic Claude model provider connection that allows Meshery to interact with Claude for AI inference.

registered.description: Connects to Anthropic Claude and makes its models available in Meshery.
Keeps the Anthropic Claude registration but stops Meshery from connecting to or acting on it. You can connect it again whenever you choose.

connected.description: Disconnects Anthropic Claude: its models stop being available in Meshery. The registration is kept, so you can connect it again later.
Removes the Anthropic Claude connection and its record from Meshery's database.

disconnected.description: Reconnects Anthropic Claude and makes its models available in Meshery again.
Removes the Anthropic Claude connection and its record from Meshery's database.

ignored.description: Re-registers the ignored connection so Meshery can attempt to connect it again.
Removes the ignored connection's record from Meshery's database.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Anthropic API.

defaultModel.title: Default Model
defaultModel.description: The default model to use for inference (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6).

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate with Anthropic Claude.
